question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql:
WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as needed_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_batches AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchase_id, pu.purchased, SUM(i.qty) as batch_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases pu ON i.purchase_id = pu.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_qty)
    GROUP BY i.product_id, i.purchase_id, pu.purchased
),
ranked_batches AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchase_id, purchased, batch_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, purchase_id) as rn
    FROM product_batches
),
fifo_picks AS (
    SELECT ob.product_id, rb.purchase_id, rb.purchased, rb.batch_qty, ob.needed_qty,
           SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) as running_total,
           CASE 
               WHEN SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) - rb.batch_qty < ob.needed_qty THEN
                   CASE 
                       WHEN SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) >= ob.needed_qty THEN 
                           ob.needed_qty - (SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) - rb.batch_qty)
                       ELSE rb.batch_qty
                   END
               ELSE 0
           END as qty_used
    FROM order_qty ob
    JOIN ranked_batches rb ON ob.product_id = rb.product_id
)
SELECT fp.product_id, p.name as product_name, 
       SUM(fp.qty_used) as total_qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fp.purchase_id) as num_batches,
       SUM(fp.qty_used) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT fp.purchase_id) as avg_units_per_batch
FROM fifo_picks fp
JOIN products p ON fp.product_id = p.id
WHERE fp.qty_used > 0
GROUP BY fp.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY fp.product_id
